Pixio NieR Gaming Monitor Features 2B and Kaine Art
A NieR 15th anniversary variant of the Pixio PX278 Wave gaming monitor is headed to Japan and has 2B and Kaine on it.

US Mitsuwa Stores and Brooklyn's Japan Village will be home to Hololive Justice Vtuber City Groove merchandise via new pop-ups.

The Switch 2 version of Stellar Blade will be at TGS 2026 and be playable, and the Shift Up CEO will make an appearance.

It'll end in Japan in November 2026.

Konami TGS 2026 Games Include Castlevania, Silent Hill, and Suikoden
The Konami TGS 2026 booth and event plans are here and include games in the Castlevania, Goemon, Silent Hill, and Suikoden series.

The Sega and Atlus TGS 2026 event and booth plans are live and include the Persona 4 remake and Sonic spin-off games.

Starsand Island on Switch 2 is such a disappointment at launch and needs at least 2-3 more patches.
